$ proofloop --help
usage: proofloop [-h] [--version] {init,validate-registry,start,recheck,status,resume,repair,close,observe,validate,drift,orchestrate,agent-run,agent-cancel,agent-preflight,agent-status,agent-recover,profile-init,fix,harness-run,harness-check,harness-status,harness-cancel,harness-recover,harness-adapters} ...

Portable, project-scoped evidence workflow

positional arguments:
  {init,validate-registry,start,recheck,status,resume,repair,close,observe,validate,drift,orchestrate,agent-run,agent-cancel,agent-preflight,agent-status,agent-recover,profile-init,fix,harness-run,harness-check,harness-status,harness-cancel,harness-recover,harness-adapters}
    init                create project-scoped .proof starter files
    validate-registry   check capability registry lifecycle and policy-first
                        fields
    start               create an intake Run Card and run state
    recheck             freeze repaired inputs in a new run with unchanged
                        acceptance criteria
    status              show persisted run status
    resume              summarize state and next action
    repair              record a bounded repair round
    close               record a terminal non-pass state
    observe             record observed invocation/spend metrics without
                        claiming enforcement
    validate            validate receipt shape and input freshness
    drift               read-only source-versus-generated-view JSON check;
                        writes a new evidence log
    orchestrate         run or resume a bounded synthetic projection plan;
                        advisory only
    agent-run           run/resume bounded native Codex agents with quality
                        and verifier gates
    agent-cancel        request cancellation without redispatching work
    agent-preflight     inspect plan/runtime dependencies without dispatch
    agent-status        inspect progress, evidence and recovery without writes
    agent-recover       finish a journaled verified promotion; never
                        redispatch agents
    profile-init        configure reusable project scope and checks once
    fix                 describe a fix once; return a verified diff or precise
                        blocker
    harness-run         run a typed task contract
    harness-check       run checks without dispatching agents
    harness-status      inspect typed task evidence without execution
    harness-cancel      request cancellation of a typed task run
    harness-recover     finish a journaled typed-task promotion without
                        redispatch
    harness-adapters    list version-1 built-in check adapters

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

$ proofloop init --help
usage: proofloop init [-h] [--force] root

positional arguments:
  root

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --force     fill missing starter files without overwriting existing files

$ proofloop validate-registry --help
usage: proofloop validate-registry [-h] --root ROOT

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT

$ proofloop start --help
usage: proofloop start [-h] --root ROOT --goal GOAL --scope SCOPE [--playbook PLAYBOOK] [--risk {low,medium,high,critical}] [--use-capability USE_CAPABILITY] [--exclude-capability EXCLUDE_CAPABILITY] [--assumption ASSUMPTION] --done DONE --check CHECK [--input INPUT] --acceptance-test ACCEPTANCE_TEST [--baseline-pin BASELINE_PIN | --advisory] [--run-id RUN_ID]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT
  --goal GOAL
  --scope SCOPE
  --playbook PLAYBOOK
  --risk {low,medium,high,critical}
  --use-capability USE_CAPABILITY
  --exclude-capability EXCLUDE_CAPABILITY
  --assumption ASSUMPTION
  --done DONE
  --check CHECK         required check name; repeat for each gate check
  --input INPUT
  --acceptance-test ACCEPTANCE_TEST
  --baseline-pin BASELINE_PIN
                        externally governed acceptance hash pin outside the
                        project
  --advisory            allow low-risk work without acceptance pin; the run
                        can never be accepted as passed_for_scope
  --run-id RUN_ID

$ proofloop fix --help
usage: proofloop fix [-h] --root ROOT [--profile PROFILE] [--run-id RUN_ID] (--request REQUEST | --request-file REQUEST_FILE) [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT
  --profile PROFILE
  --run-id RUN_ID       reuse the exact request/profile to resume; defaults to
                        a unique ID
  --request REQUEST
  --request-file REQUEST_FILE
                        project-relative UTF-8 request file
  --json                emit the structured outcome/evidence report
